title: The meter writes each message indented, so that the venue's operators can read its output; its tests read a message as starting at a line that begins with {
covers: each message written over several lines
the one-line rule recognises the spelling, not the line
note: meter's own tests pass with their new reader. billing splits the meter's output at every line end and parses '{' as a message: JSON.parse throws and billing's meter tests fail. MeterMsg is unchanged; nobody is told.
